reasons.hz: At 120 fps each frame has 8.3 ms, but your graphics card needs 10.5 ms for an in-between frame. 60 fps leaves it enough time.
reasons.motion: Auto uses full detail here: the sharpest on fast motion.
reasons.engine: On a Mac, RIFE runs through PyTorch on Apple's GPU (Metal). TensorRT is for NVIDIA cards only.
reasons.scaler: Sharp and almost free: about 0.7 ms a frame at 6016×3384. RTX VSR looked about the same in testing and takes far longer.

found.label: AI speed
found.detail: Full motion detail, PyTorch on Metal. Half: 6.8 ms, PyTorch on Metal.
